title: An inbox_row upsert at the held row's position replaces it, but what it counts at or below the row's read seq stays read
why: An inbox_row upsert is a GET /api/channels/inbox?ids= answer delivered by the sync pull, applied through the same merge: an equal position is a newer answer of the same row (a read, a Done or a follow change moves no position) and replaces it. The merge keeps the higher read seq (the row's and the answer's), so an upsert computed before a read that reached the client first does not bring that unread back (Tenny, #triage:#244).
